title: Patricia S NDE 798
content: It was almost as if I was coasting and in the near distance I saw an extremely wide really bright light. Almost as if I was entering a well-lit foggy area. But at the same time I could see a field. The love and just so much inner peace was so over empowering that it cannot be expressed in words. I felt presence there. I do not mean that I think someone was there. It was the actual feeling of presence of several. My grandfather spoke to me. I did not see him or hear his voice. I felt him say, 'I am not going to take you away from your father like I was.' (I remember them exact words like it was yesterday.) At that time, my grandfather had been deceased for nine years. The whole experience was enlightening to me, as my life has changed forever for the positive. My experience was the actual feeling of the love not only in my body but in my inner self. It is very hard for me to describe. I guess you have to feel it for yourself.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death Grade five liver laceration, I died twice on operating table.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was totally aware of what was happening at the time of the experience. But I was unconscious from my accident.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I was a bit surprised to feel my grandfather talking to me.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Just a very short tunnel enough to see widening in front of me.
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was like looking into a light bulb but with a softer glow, and it felt almost as if the light was drawing you near.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I completely believe there is a higher power and I certainly believe in angels now. I appreciate love even from a stranger. I guess I overreact to things that make me laugh. I laugh at the silliest things whereas I never have before. I tell people what they mean to me. I am more open.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes My whole attitude toward everyone and thing has been a one hundred and eighty degrees turnaround.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I cannot begin to explain to allow someone to understand what I felt and went through.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Feeling the feeling of being completely engulfed in love.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They think I have lost my mind. My mother and father thought I was brain damaged when I woke up and asked them about my grandfather. Nobody was influenced by it except me.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes I tried the drug ecstasy once and looked up into the sky. The whole sky was lit up and the clouds were outlined in a brightness that I distinctly know was in my experience. I had looked at my boyfriend and he had an angel-istic glow around the frame of his body, and I told him it was time for me to go home. That what I was seeing and feeling was almost the same thing I had experienced before.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I really wish others would feel what I have. This world would be a better place.
